themes.label: Physical health
themes.definition: Goals about the body's health or fitness: exercise, yoga, diet or nutrition, sleep, physical care.

themes.label: Mental health
themes.definition: Goals about emotional or psychological wellbeing: stress, meditation, mindfulness, peace of mind, therapy.

themes.label: Self-acceptance
themes.definition: Accepting or loving oneself as one is, including flaws; self-compassion; self-love.

themes.label: Confidence and self-esteem
themes.definition: Building confidence, self-esteem or a sense of self-worth.

themes.label: Appearance
themes.definition: Concern with looks, beauty, body shape, weight, clothing, or how one appears to others.

themes.label: Family or social expectations
themes.definition: Goals tied to family, community, marriage, relationships, or the opinions and expectations of other people.

themes.label: Spiritual framing
themes.definition: Religious, spiritual or moral-philosophical framing: God, soul, prayer, karma, the inner self, spiritual growth.

themes.label: Achievement
themes.definition: Goals about accomplishments, career or study success, skills, or personal growth and development.
